skipProps.height: Figma strokes do not consume layout; CSS borders do. The board's 48 is the frame, and the shipped bar is 48 plus its 1px bottom rule — the same export artifact recorded across this arc (see media's w-[280px] family). The bar's fill, border COLOUR and inset are all joined and pass; only the stroke's pixel is refused.
